answer: The novel follows disgraced financial journalist Mikael Blomkvist and investigator Lisbeth Salander, who is hired to investigate Blomkvist and notices connections among him, Henrik Vanger and financier Hans-Erik Wennerström. [E1] The central mystery is the disappearance of Henrik’s niece Harriet from Hedeby Island; Henrik believes she was murdered, but she is later revealed to be alive and recently returned from Australia.
